name: MoYu WeiLong Ferrocore V2 3x3 (Magnetic, 20-Magnet Ball-Core)
description: The MoYu WeiLong Ferrocore V2 3x3 (Magnetic, 20-Magnet Ball-Core) is CubeHead's Ferrocore, rebuilt on the MoYu WeiLong V11. Strong magnets, a flexible core, and a matte frosted finish make it a cube that feels balanced at speed and stays easy to set up.
features: Matte, low-shine finish: Frosted plastic gives the cube a matte look with less shine than a UV coating.
CubeHead collector packaging: Comes in a custom CubeHead-designed box with a collectible CubeHead card.
Tension, 1 to 8: Controls how tightly the pieces are held. Lower settings turn lighter; higher settings feel more locked in.
Compression, 1 to 8: Controls how firm the springs are, so you can make each turn feel softer or snappier.
Adjustment tool in the box: One tool handles both settings.
Fixed magnet strength: The magnets come set from the factory, which leaves two simple settings to tune instead of a long list.
